Results.ReviewText: Only problem is the grates. The food likes to stick to them unless you read the blog. The temp has to be high for steak meat etc. Puttong oil on product will help. Only con. The grill is well made and good on propane. Would recommend to friends.
Results.Title: Could Be 5 stars!

Results.ReviewText: Have had my Weber about a month and love it. Its the perfect size for the two of us. Flame adjustment works great unlike some grills where you have 2 settings high or blast furnace. Easy to clean.
Results.Title: Best grill I have ever owned.

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. Had it for about a month now and have to say the best gas grill I’ve ever used. Easy to light, easy to control, and cooks great. Bought it to take with us in our RV but it works so good I use it at the house as well.
Results.Title: Great features

Results.ReviewText: Room for plenty of food and cooks great just the right size.
Results.Title: Easy to maintain.

Results.ReviewText:
This is my second Weber Q grill.  I bought the original model 8 or 9 years ago and have loved using it all that time.  The only reason I bought the new one was because I recently had a bone marrow transplant and it was going to cost nearly as much to get my old Q steam cleaned as buying the new one.  I do love the electric igniter on the new one as it lights so much nicer than my old Q.  It is just my wife and I so the size of the Q is perfect for cooking for two.  If we have company coming I have a much larger Weber Genesis for that.  

It took all of 5 minutes to set up out of the box and it is very durable.  I like the addition of the thermometer to the newer model.  We also got the cart for it and connect it to a full size propane tank when not traveling.  For 199$ you will never regret this.  I bought my first one at Kohl's with a coupon and paid 150$ for it so watch for deals like that.
Results.Title: Best portable grill on the market

Results.UserLocation: full time RV all over the west
Results.ReviewText: I had two grills I traveled with and had been thinking about a Q1000 for a while and got the Q1200. Wish I had replaced other grills and bought it sooner. I love it, the food turns out great. Highly recommend it. Light weight and easy to store.
Results.Title: Great full time RV'er grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this a little over a month ago after debating buying it for a couple of years. I’ve always been intimidated by the idea of grilling but this grill has put those concerns to rest. It was easy to assemble and it’s even easier to use! It’s the perfect size for my balcony, it’s  easy to transport for grilling in the park and looks great too. I’ve truly enjoyed having this grill as a cooking option this summer and would definitely recommend it!!!
Results.Title: I love it!!!

Results.ReviewText: I bought my grill in the summer of 2017. Living in the south, we have an extended grilling season, so we grill every weekend. It's very efficient, we have only exchanged our tank once in that time. It's small, but large enough our needs. It heats up quickly and evenly. Overall I think it's a great buy for a small family or couple.
Results.Title: Small and Efficient

Results.ReviewText: Love the fact that we can clean grills in kitchen sink.  Works great and cooks quickly!
Results.Title: Overall great!

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! We are very glad to hear you are enjoying your new grill so far! We are sorry to hear about the issue with attaching your igniter and your recent experience with us. We have reached out to you via email to help get your igniter replaced so it will connect like it should. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill for our 2 week road trip across the country and we grilled either steaks, lamb chops, ribs, burgers and hot dogs to perfection every single night and everything was delicious! The grill is so reliable. It is incredibly well-made and durable however the ignitor button is surprisingly very insecure and falls off when you "properly insert it" which can cause you to lose it without realizing. When I called customer service to ask them about it when I was assembling the grill the rep went to examine a company sample Grill and told me that hers  was the same story, and she apologized. But at least I know that they are all like that and not just mine. I can't believe they didn't fix this issue. I ended up just connecting the button to the ignitor and let it hang loose which is really annoying and didn't insert in in between the metal holder. Besides for that issue it's 5 Stars.
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever!

Results.ReviewText: I live in an apartment complex that allows no grills. I carry this grill out to a stone area near the parking lot and have had great success with it. It heats up enough to sear the meat, then allows convection or direct heat cooking. Very happy with it. My last Weber grill is over 18 years old and still working fine. It's just kind of large to move 200 feet and back, and so it is in storage. I can't imagine a better portable grill for tailgating, camping, or the beach. Very very happy with it. Would highly recommend it.
Results.Title: Weber quality throughout

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a few weeks ago and cannot say enough about how perfect it is for me!  Burgers and hot dogs when the grand-kids come over or steaks and shrimp on the barbecue.  Perfect size and easy clean up.  Get one!
Results.Title: Handy and Dandy

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a month ago as a replacement for my other WeberQ, which I had for about 10 years. I have used it several times and I love it. It is so easy to use. Some of the new features that I love are: the temperature gauge, the split grill (making it easier to remove and clean, and the digital ignite. It lights the first time every time.  I also love that it has shelves that fold out to put things on.
Results.Title: Great Features!

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill.   Weber quality!   Heavy duty construction but transportable for camping.    I like that it uses the small propane canisters.    Cooks evenly - no hot spots.
Results.Title: Great Camp Grill

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this a month ago, this is our 3rd Weber, I have big one, charcoal and now
down size for 2 of us, work perfect in townhouse , rain or shine with add on cart,
I can moved it very easy
Results.Title: nice small grill

Results.ReviewText: Gift from my son in June as an addition to a full sized, cumbersome grill which we use when the family is over.(14 ppl) I wanted an easy to use, compact grill to cook only for myself. I like using the small, disposable propane tank. Works great, cooks faster than I’m used to so a learning curve there. I only wish I’d bought the Weber Grill Cover at time of purchase because I left it outside and the drip tray filled with grease/rain water. It was a mess to clean up. but very pleased with the grill!
Results.Title: Easy to use!
